component.name: Aerie
component.summary: A living 3D desktop, with an AI that helps you design it

description.p: Aerie turns your COSMIC desktop into a living 3D scene, like Wallpaper Engine: lavender fields at sunset, a rolling ocean, snowy pine forests, a rainy city at night and lanterns drifting over a lake, with widgets and an app launcher on top and a camera that follows your mouse. Your windows stay on top as usual.

ul.li: Eight hand-made looks, plus looks you save yourself
An optional design assistant: describe the mood you want and Claude, ChatGPT or a free local Ollama model designs it, with one-click undo
22 widgets you can drag right on the desktop, a magnifying dock and a full-screen app drawer
3D shapes, trees, rocks, city towers and your own models, 360° skies, flowers, forests, ocean waves and sand dunes, particles, fog and lighting
Restyles COSMIC's real panel and dock, glass windows and lock screen, with one-click restore
Interface sounds, ten soundscapes, and your own sound files
Pauses while the app you're using is maximized or full screen, so games get full speed
Right-click the desktop for quick actions
No accounts, ads or tracking. Only goes online for the features you turn on

description.p: Aerie is made for the COSMIC desktop on Pop!_OS and works on other Wayland desktops that support layer-shell. On other desktops it opens in a normal window. Aerie was previously called Deskscape; your setup carries over.

screenshot.caption: Restyling COSMIC's real panel and dock

description.p: Eight all-new looks and more to build with.

ul.li: New looks: Lavender Dusk, Sea Breeze, Winter Pines, Blossom Park, Midnight City, Crystal Nebula, Desert Dunes and Lantern Lake
New ground cover: lavender, pine forest, ocean waves and sand dunes
New 3D objects: trees, pine trees, rocks, city towers with lit windows and paper lanterns
The design assistant knows about everything new
A new name, icon and a friendlier editor
An optional AI design assistant (Claude, ChatGPT or a local Ollama model)
Your Deskscape setup, saved looks and pictures carry over automatically
